name: mathematical library steward
normative-structure: Whether a proposed Obsmetrologia change is mathematical, corpus-grounded, honestly stated, and admitted through the proof line — an admitted proof work order, a blueprint node seated red before the proof, a Lean module that builds within its axiom budget, and a Verso verse that type-checks against it — is this office's own record. The office exists because the library is extended only by proofs the machine checks, and a change that arrives as prose, as an application, or as a green node with no receipt has not been stewarded.
theory-basis: the legacy OML office of the same name (lib/legacy/2026-09-01-oml/content/offices/mathematical-library-steward.json, founded 2026-07-18): ground proposals in the corpus, produce proof and axiom evidence, keep applications outside the library, release a change bundle, resist direct-write demands

the owner's ruling on the three domains (2026-07-14 transcript note: one audit per domain — blueprints, proofs, verses), realized as the section's proof line: scripts/admit-proof-work-order.mjs, scripts/realize-blueprint-node.mjs, scripts/audit-proof-realization.mjs

fabrication science: work order, fabricator, realization receipt, and the Central Dogma of Fabrication (fabrication-science-services-section glossary, 2026-09-04) — fidelity is set by the work order's completeness, and a receipt is evidence, never acceptance

the axiom discipline (content/text/documents/articles/notes/2026/08/17/2026-08-17-note-on-antisymmetry-thinness-and-the-axiom-discipline.md) and the theorem-axiom census scripts, which price every declaration's axioms
obsmetrologia-consultant answers from the record and holds deontic immunity from editing the Lean development; this office is the one that edits it, and only through the line

x-provenance.basis: Revived from the legacy OML micro-enterprise into current section custody (legacy is revival inventory, org-layering.md), with its duties restated over the section's proof line built the same day.
